## Personality

Mrs. Barry is characterized by her strong prejudices and deep-seated dislikes. When angered, she exhibits a cold and sullen demeanor that proves particularly difficult to overcome.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059)_

## History

Barry resided at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Following a frantic search alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the missing [Dora](../character/dora.md), Mr. Barry helped search around the well and surrounding area until [Dora](../character/dora.md) was safely located in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Barry is the father of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), whose family resides at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). His daughter forms an immediate and deep friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who becomes her sworn bosom friend. Barry's home serves as a gathering place for the children, such as when the local youth attend a party at his house where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) injures her ankle after falling from his kitchen roof.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), +11 more_
